answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one inlet weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 281 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 209 times the capital for one share. The ember report reveals the merge explicitly at each walnut. A farm of 4424 identities would post 1640 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
